# Unvalidated concept catalogs

This directory contains operator-supplied indexes that may nominate questions
or concepts for later retrieval. They are not `/learn` fixtures, memory
crystals, kernel axioms, or validated `ConceptRecord` values.

`notebooklm-ontology-index.json` preserves the 17 rows and seven document
references from the supplied NotebookLM workbook. Document indices are not
exact passage provenance. Intake therefore stages each proposed name as a
workspace `CONCEPT` and every descriptive field as a `HYPOTHESIS`, with no
intrinsic order, derivation seal, validation reference, or promotion authority.
